In this scenario the current acceleration, part of which the MD&A attributes to currency tailwinds in Greater China and Europe, does not repeat against a high comparison base, and growth falls back to the pace of the three fiscal years before this one.

terminal_growth.reason: A very large, mature company whose revenue compounded at about this rate over the three fiscal years before the current acceleration; the bear case treats the flat stretch as the pattern and lets the perpetual rate sit well under the risk-free rate, which is the ceiling Python enforces, on the view that trade disputes and consumer sentiment cap long-run growth near nominal prices.
